newsitem.title: UK: WPP chief hints at breakup - paper.
newsitem.headline: WPP chief hints at breakup - paper.

text.p: Martin Sorrell, chief executive of advertising group WPP Plc, has hinted that the company could be broken up in five years if it does not add enough shareholder value, a report in the Financial Times said.
In an interview with the paper, Sorrell said: "The basic issue is shareholder value. I don't see the point of having a group of companies together that don't add value."
The FT said future options could include divestment, restructuring or reducing the role of head office to a mere holding company, if insufficient value was being added.
WPP owns the Ogilvy & Mather and J Walter Thompson agencies.
